hints: Write the body (everything except the checksum) into one `ByteArrayOutputStream`, compute the CRC of those bytes, then write body plus checksum. Reading does the same in reverse: the last 8 bytes are the stored checksum, the rest is the body.
Check in the order a reader can: magic first, then version, then the checksum, and only then trust the rest. `readFully` throws `EOFException` (an `IOException`) when the data ends early.
